content.short: Verilog Solutions is a full-stack Web3 security firm focusing on smart contract, consensus, and operational security.
content.description: Verilog Solutions is a full-stack Web3 security firm specializing in smart contract security, consensus security, and operational security for Web3 projects. The team provides end-to-end security assessments and hardening across contract design, network consensus, and day-to-day operations. Additionally, they offer pro bono consulting to developers building Web3 applications, supporting efforts that advance sustainability, climate action, energy transition, and broader environmental, social, and governance (ESG) goals.
content.meta: Verilog Solutions provides full-stack security for Web3 projects. Discover Verilog Solutions and other Web3 Security Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
